activity_statements.statement: manufactures and sells agricultural equipment including tractors (22–830 HP), combines, planters, and forage harvesters for farmers worldwide
manufactures and sells construction equipment including excavators, loaders, and dozers for contractors and infrastructure operators
operates the John Deere Operations Center, an online farm management platform for real-time field monitoring, work planning, and yield analysis via web, tablet, and phone
deploys autonomous tractor technology allowing the 8R tractor to operate with or without an operator in the field
sells See & Spray precision weed-targeting technology that detects and sprays individual weeds across multiple crop types
provides Gator Utility Vehicles and attachments for farm, industrial, and recreational use
supports dairy farmers with specialized equipment portfolios and dealer-provided agronomic advisory services

name_reality_gap: The John Deere name and green-tractor imagery signals heavy equipment manufacturer; the company is rapidly becoming a precision-agriculture technology company — deploying autonomous tractors, cloud-based farm management platforms, and AI-driven weed targeting — making it as much a software and data firm as an iron manufacturer.
